text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Yaeno Muteki and I are out shopping. The streets around us are full of activity and festooned in all kinds of bright and cheery colors.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The end of the year is upon us… I always seem to forget until I see the town decorated.
choice_data_list: You don't do anything special during the holidays?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: By myself? Not particularly. Though I have gone to parties thrown by the academy and my dorm in the past.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I learned of the tradition of exchanging gifts at the latter.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And what a fine tradition it is. As long as there are people celebrating with you, then it doesn't matter what gift you receive.
choice_data_list: How did you usually spend the winter holidays back home?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We didn't do anything extravagant. We'd decorate a tree and have roasted chicken for dinner. Oh, we would eat cake too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As for presents…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Did you know that only good children get presents during this time?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's why Santa never came to visit me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Or more accurately, he would always come late.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: My stocking's empty… But I've been a good girl.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: For the past few days, perhaps. But what about last week? And last month?

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: …Urk.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. Santa always has an eye on you, so as long as you stay on your best behavior, I'm sure he'll come by with your present.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And so I'd focus on my training, and I really would receive a present several days later.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It was so satisfying to know Santa cared enough to watch over me and would reward me with a gift if I rectified my bad behavior.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm… Though now that I think of it, perhaps the mere fact that Santa saw my efforts was enough to fulfill my desire for attention.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I could simply receive a present without doing anything special, I probably wouldn't have even thought to apply myself to my training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But because I was initially judged as naughty, the acknowledgement of redeeming myself was all the more gratifying.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Grampa must have been aware of my true desire ever since back then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt that the stipulations she had to navigate in order to receive a present contributed to her growth, but still…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel somewhat sorry for her, knowing that she never got a present from Santa on time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are. So what is it you wanted my help with?
choice_data_list: I want you to be Santa for Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki is such a hard worker, so I want her to receive a proper present from Santa—and on time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To enact the plan, I decide to ask Fuji Kiseki, the leader of the Ritto dorm, for assistance. I proceed to give her a rundown of the situation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …Ahh, what a splendid idea! I'd be more than happy to be of assistance!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To summarize, you'd like me to deliver a present to Yaeno on the eve of the big day, correct?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: After all, one's stocking should already be filled with Santa's presents by the time you wake up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since I can't enter Ritto Dormitory myself, I have to rely on somebody on the inside to do the actual gift-giving for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My only concern is how alert Yaeno Muteki is. Thanks to her martial arts background, she's constantly aware of her surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I warn Fuji Kiseki that, even fast asleep, Yaeno might be able to sense her presence if she tries sneaking into the room.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, don't you fret! I'll have you know I'm proficient in sleight of hand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I can slip into her room while she's out and make it so she won't find her present until the morning of!
choice_data_list: Wow, you can really do that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course! Consider it done! It'd be my pleasure to take part in such a lovely surprise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, on the fateful day…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Um… Thank you very much for the present.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This gift here. You were the one who got this for me, yes?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh! I assume you meant to surprise me by putting it in my stocking.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I happened to find it underneath my bed after dinner last night…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If only the pencil I dropped hadn't rolled under my bed!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm so terribly sorry! It's all my fault that this act of kindness from you and Fuji went to waste!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to be done since she found the present on accident. I just feel bad for Fuji Kiseki, who went through the trouble of helping.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Um, however… It made me very happy. To receive a gift, of course…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But also knowing you went through so much trouble for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. My apologies. I can't stop smiling…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although the surprise was a flop, I still managed to put a smile on Yaeno Muteki's face!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Take a look at this! Santa graced me with a present!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I found it when I woke up this morning!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It was tucked snugly within my stocking. That can only mean it came from Santa himself!
choice_data_list: He must've visited you because you've been good this year!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I knew it! Santa's identity remains a mystery to me…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But I'll put that aside for now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Finally… Finally, I've been seen as a good child!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aah! If only I could convey my joy and gratitude to him!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But as much as I would like to, it'd be uncouth to try and uncover his identity.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm… I wonder if Santa would receive a thank-you letter if I put it in my stocking?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The surprise was a resounding success, leaving Yaeno Muteki in great spirits!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later, with Fuji Kiseki's assistance once again, I receive Yaeno Muteki's thank-you letter.
